entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: A fusion of three dryads (Oba, Ses and Cim), nominal guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave and speaker for Mat'Selesnya on Ravnica.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The wild dryad of Life who became the central head of Trostani and organized the murders at Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Ses
entities.description: The orderly dryad of Order, one of the three sisters who form Trostani.

entities.name: Cim
entities.description: The eldest dryad, of Harmony, the bridge between her two sisters.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Ravnican guild devoted to nature and harmony, led by Trostani.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The World Tree of the Selesnya Conclave.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The tree Trostani is tied to, later replanted in a Selesnya park.

entities.name: Suniel
entities.description: A Parun who bound the three dryads to an old oak tree and fused them with the World Tree.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: Stepped forward to fill the leadership void during the War of the Spark and again after the murders.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who convinced Trostani to fight Bolas and later fought Oba.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Brainwashed by Oba into killing Zegana and later helped trap Oba.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Simic leader murdered by Oba's brainwashed instrument for experimenting with Phyrexian oil.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Murdered by Oba for appearing to collaborate as a double agent; later a ghost.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: Accidentally killed by Oba.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: One of Oba's targets for profiting from the conflict.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: The master detective who solved the murders.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Threatened to arrest Oba for the murders.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Analyzed the Guildpact to look for a rationale to arrest Oba.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war against Bolas.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion that damaged Trostani and spurred Oba's plan.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Phyrexian tendrils that Oba shielded Vitu-Ghazi from.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon enemy of the War of the Spark.

events.summary: The three dryad sisters enter a trance to reconnect with Mat'Selesnya; Suniel binds them to an old oak and the Parun fuses them with the World Tree, creating Trostani.
events.quote: this old Parun fused the three dryads with the World Tree, creating Trostani.

events.summary: Before the War of the Spark the three heads of Trostani are in discord, leaving her paralyzed; Emmara Tandris fills the leadership void.
events.quote: During the War, Emmara Tandris stepped forward to fill the void in leadership.

events.summary: Kaya's party convinces Trostani to join the fight against Bolas and she becomes concordant again.
events.quote: was convinced by Kaya 's party to join the fight against Bolas and became concordant again.

events.summary: During the Invasion Oba secretly embodies Vitu-Ghazi to protect it from corruption, witnesses profiteers, and resolves to cleanse Ravnica.
events.quote: She came to believe that Ravnica needed to be cleansed of these profiteers, and hatched a plan to do so.

events.summary: Vitu-Ghazi is replanted in a Selesnya park and the dryads change positions, with Oba at the center.
events.quote: Vitu-Ghazi was replanted in a Selesnya park, and Trostani moved along with it.

events.summary: Oba uses pollen from flowers sprouted from Vitu-Ghazi's roots to put citizens in a fugue state and make them kill her targets anonymously.
events.quote: transforming them into lethal weapons with which to slay her targets anonymously.

events.summary: Oba brainwashes Etrata into killing Zegana, drawing media attention and the detective Alquist Proft.
events.quote: when she brainwashed Etrata into killing Zegana , the case began to attract media attention

events.summary: Oba gets away with the murder of Teysa Karlov and accidentally kills Kylox.
events.quote: Oba managed to get away with the murder of Teysa Karlov and accidentally killed Kylox .

events.summary: Proft reveals at Vitu-Ghazi that Oba organized the murders as retribution against those she considered traitors.
events.quote: Proft revealed that Trostani — specifically Oba — was responsible for organizing the murders

events.summary: Oba resists arrest, renders her sisters unconscious, animates Vitu-Ghazi and attacks the guild leaders, seriously injuring Etrata.
events.quote: She animated Vitu-Ghazi and attacked the guild leaders, seriously injuring Etrata.

events.summary: Kaya, with Etrata's help, traps Oba within barrier wards and her sisters render her unconscious.
events.quote: trapping Oba within barrier wards, giving her sisters time to render her unconscious.

events.summary: Oba's sisters enter meditation, leaving Emmara Tandris to lead; Kaya regrets not killing Oba and Teysa's ghost promises a punishing lawsuit.
events.quote: leaving Emmara Tandris to lead the guild.

relations.quote: Trostani is the nominal guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave on Ravnica

relations.note: One of the three dryads fused into Trostani.
relations.quote: Trostani is a fusion of three dryads .
Oba's sisters were embarrassed for her wrongdoing
Oba's sisters were embarrassed for her wrongdoing

relations.note: Fused the dryads with the World Tree.
relations.quote: this old Parun fused the three dryads with the World Tree, creating Trostani.

relations.note: Murdered her for appearing to collaborate.
relations.quote: Oba managed to get away with the murder of Teysa Karlov

relations.note: Kaya fought back and trapped her.
relations.quote: However, Kaya Cassir fought back, phasing through the vines of Vitu-Ghazi

relations.note: Left to lead the guild during Trostani's meditation.
relations.quote: leaving Emmara Tandris to lead the guild.
